custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a custom role for this test, role B, with Vendor Order Management — View and Vendor Order Management — Create & Edit ticked and every Part Library & Inventory box unticked, so user B reaches parts only through Vendor Order Management.
  • Create a staff member for this test, user B, at the test location with role B, so the steps run with role B's permissions.
  • Use a second browser window (a private window) signed in as user B.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A, and an inactive part, part A, with vendor A.

Setup

  1. Make vendor A: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425746 VENDOR A in Name *. Click Save & Close.
  2. Make role B: Click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Roles & Permissions in the left menu, then Create Custom Role. In Choose a template click Skip. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425746 ROLE B in Role Name*. Switch on Parts Department and tick only View and Create & Edit on the Vendor and order management row. Click Create. Leave See Financial Data (under Cross-Cutting Toggles) off.
  3. Sign in as user B: The QA site's sign-in offers only Admin and Tech, so user B is the shared Tech sign-in given role B. Click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Staff in the left menu. Click Search, type tech@shopview.com, click the edit icon at the end of Tech ShopView's row, pick ZZAUTOTEST PL C425746 ROLE B under Role and click Save & Close. In the private window choose Tech on the sign-in screen. When the test is finished, set Tech ShopView's Role back to Technician the same way.
  4. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425746 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425746-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Vendor: vendor A; Quantity (in the bin row): 1. Click Save.
  5. Set part A inactive: On the Inventory page click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425746-A. Click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate.
